records.subject: Hydroelectronic drag
records.object: Direct efficient conversion of small-scale waste-flow kinetic energy into electricity
records.quote: Here, we predict that the kinetic energy of small-scale waste flows can be directly and efficiently converted into electricity thanks to the hydroelectronic drag effect, by which an ion-free liquid induces an electronic current in the solid wall along which it flows.
